name: Nerui
source:
Mizari's childhood friend and confidant.

Being the big sister type, she's always doted on and taken care of those around her.

Lately however, something is off with her; she is more spacey than usual.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/mizari-loves-company]itch.io[/url]]
